3) & \frac{b^2-a^2}{a^2b^2} \cdot \frac{a^2b^2}{(b-a)^2} = \\
& = \frac{(b-a)(b+a) \cdot a^2b^2}{a^2b^2 \cdot (b-a)^2} = \frac{b+a}{b-a}; \\
4) & \frac{b+a}{b-a} - 1 = \frac{b+a}{b-a} - \frac{b-a}{b-a} = \\
& = \frac{b+a-b+a}{b-a} = \frac{2a}{b-a}.
\end{aligned}
$$

7. Примените к выражению алгоритм сокращения рациональной дроби:
а) $\frac{5\sqrt{b}+b\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{b}+\sqrt{5}}$
б) $\frac{m-2\sqrt{3m}+3}{3-m}$

Решение:
а)
$$
\frac{5\sqrt{b}+b\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{b}+\sqrt{5}} = \frac{\sqrt{5b}(\sqrt{5}+\sqrt{b})}{\sqrt{b}+\sqrt{5}} = \sqrt{5b};
$$
б)
$$
\frac{m-2\sqrt{3m}+3}{3-m} = \frac{(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{m})^2}{(\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{m})(\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{m})} = \frac{\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{m}}{\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{m}}.
$$

8. Упростите выражение
$$
\left(\frac{\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b}}{\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}} + \frac{2\sqrt{ab}}{a-b}\right) \cdot \frac{a-2\sqrt{ab}+b}{a+b}.
$$

Решение:
1)
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \frac{\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b}}{\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}} + \frac{2\sqrt{ab}}{a-b} = \\
& = \frac{\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b}}{\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}} + \frac{2\sqrt{ab}}{(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})(\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b})} = \\
& = \frac{(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})^2 + 2\sqrt{ab}}{(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})(\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b})} = \\
& = \frac{a-2\sqrt{ab}+b+2\sqrt{ab}}{(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})(\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b})} = \\
& = \frac{a+b}{(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})(\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b})};
\end{aligned}
$$
2)
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \frac{a+b}{(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})(\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b})} \cdot \frac{a-2\sqrt{ab}+b}{a+b} = \\
& = \frac{(a+b) \cdot (\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})^2}{(\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b})(\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}) \cdot (a+b)} = \\
& = \frac{\sqrt{a}-\sqrt{b}}{\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}}.
\end{aligned}
$$
